title: Rational Koszul braiding commutes with the prescribed scalar comparison
statement: Let ℓ be prime, Ω an algebraic closure of Q_ℓ, and W a scheme on which ℓ is invertible in every residue field. For finite coefficient indices E ≤ L, the prescribed rational scalar extension and normalized tensor scalar comparison commute with the prescribed rational Koszul braiding: for all A,B, λ_{EL;B,A} ∘ F_{EL}(σ^E_{A,B}) = σ^L_{F_{EL}A,F_{EL}B} ∘ λ_{EL;A,B}.

source.place: Tag 0FPQ (signed total symmetry), with the scalar-extension refinement in the normalized common-stage tensor paragraph

proof.text: Unfold the prescribed rational scalar extension, rational tensor comparison, and rational braiding on their defining localized representatives. The comparison and braiding components are the localizations of the prescribed integral comparison and integral braiding, while scalar extension sends a localized pure tensor a ⊗ f to the image scalar tensored with the integral scalar extension of f.

On integral representatives, the two composites are equal by [lem-pur-integral-braiding-scalar-extension-square]. Bilinearity and the balancing relation of raw scalar localization extend this equality to all localized morphisms and preserve it for E = L and ramified extensions.

theorem rationalBraidingScalarExtensionSquare
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (Ω : Type v) [Field Ω] [Algebra (Padic l) Ω]
    [IsAlgClosure (Padic l) Ω]
    (W : Scheme.{u})
    [∀ w : W, Invertible (l : W.residueField w)] :
    ∀ (E L : AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Index l Ω) (hEL : E ≤ L),
      ∀ (A B : sfRationalConstructibleCategory l
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) W),
        (sfRationalScalarExtension l
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) W 0
          (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime))
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L)
          (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.coefficientInclusion l Ω E L hEL)).map
            (pullbackTensorRationalBraiding l
              (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) W A B).hom ≫
          (rationalTensorScalarComparison l
            (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω E)
            (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L)
            (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.coefficientInclusion l Ω E L hEL) W).hom.app
            (B, A) =
        (rationalTensorScalarComparison l
            (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω E)
            (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L)
            (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.coefficientInclusion l Ω E L hEL) W).hom.app
            (A, B) ≫
          (pullbackTensorRationalBraiding l
            (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L) W
            ((sfRationalScalarExtension l
              (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) W 0
              (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime))
              (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L)
              (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.coefficientInclusion l Ω E L hEL)).obj A)
            ((sfRationalScalarExtension l
              (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω E) W 0
              (Nat.Prime.ne_zero (Fact.out : l.Prime))
              (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.Coefficient.{u} l Ω L)
              (AlgebraicallyClosedCoefficients.coefficientInclusion l Ω E L hEL)).obj B)).hom
